name: exec-msgs-duplicate
description: The same import twice — byte-identical keys. Caught by the same strictly-increasing rule as the unsorted case, and worth its own fixture because a `<=` check instead of `<` would let it through, silently admitting a multiplicity the dedup rule exists to erase. Contrast `exec-msgs-same-identifier-different-msghash`, which is VALID: same coordinate, different payload hash, hence a different key.
expectedError: invalid proof batch: blocks[0].execMsgs[1] duplicates its predecessor; execMsgs is a deduplicated set, strictly increasing in the canonical key
